messages.subject: error in table of probability of ranges of each nodes
parts:
Hi,

I was trying to get a table of probability of ranges of each nodes. I have used the link below after a DEC run.

http://phylo.wikidot.com/example-biogeobears-scripts#node_probabilities

However I ran into some issues. 

1)I receive this error message: Error in names(range_probabilities) = ranges_list : 
 'names' attribute [11] must be the same length as the vector [8]
2)When the names of possible ranges show up on the screen, there is a blank range at the beginning: ranges_list
 [1] "_"  "S"  "I"  "A"  "O"  "SI" "SA" "SO" "IA" "IO" "AO"
3)The number of columns are less than the number of ranges in the output file.

It will be great if someone could help me out with this.

Thanks,

Maitreya

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] error in table of probability of ranges of each nodes
parts: This one is easy ish:

On Mon, Feb 11, 2019 at 11:38 PM Maitreya Sil <maitre...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I was trying to get a table of probability of ranges of each nodes. I have used the link below after a DEC run.

http://phylo.wikidot.com/example-biogeobears-scripts#node_probabilities

However I ran into some issues. 

1)I receive this error message: Error in names(range_probabilities) = ranges_list : 
 'names' attribute [11] must be the same length as the vector [8]

You need to get ranges_list to be of length 11, so look at the line setting it up. This seems to say it has length 8. You could just manually write it out:

ranges_list = c("_",  "S",  "I",  "A",  "O",  "SI", "SA", "SO", "IA", "IO", "AO")

2)When the names of possible ranges show up on the screen, there is a blank range at the beginning: ranges_list
 [1] "_"  "S"  "I"  "A"  "O"  "SI" "SA" "SO" "IA" "IO" "AO"

That's the null range, that is expected behavior under defaults (where include_null_range=TRUE)
 
Cheers!
